experiments.research_question: Can a computational method integrate deep learning with biological knowledge graphs to predict transcriptional outcomes of single and multigene perturbations, including those involving unseen genes?

limitations.statement: GEARS must be trained on the same cell type or experimental condition for reliable predictions.
Training GEARS using combinatorial perturbation data is essential for accurate multigene prediction.
Various confounding factors such as cell cycle effects, assumed success of gene editing, and postperturbation distribution heterogeneity can influence accuracy.
GEARS may have limited ability to predict outcomes for perturbing previously unperturbed genes that are not well connected in the knowledge graph.
